lines.label: instructions
lines.text: Today's cross word puzzle offers still another variation in the series. Instead of solving the puzzle in the usual way see if you can first complete it by filling in the blank squares with letters so as to spell words when read either across or up and down.

lines.label: instructions
lines.text: You do not require a numbered list of clews and definitions to work out this puzzle. Just think of a house and the furniture, fittings and supplies you will find in a house. With this clew to work on, you can readily call to mind nearly all the words needed to complete the puzzle. The solution, or rather the completed puzzle, will appear in next week's FUN.
